plausibility_notes: Introductions establish a coherent museum gala with several plausible overlapping financial, provenance, restitution, and artistic tensions.
Pun names and nearly universal polished one-liners make the tone deliberately theatrical. That feels compatible with a party mystery, though less like spontaneous speech.
Thirty introductions at once create a high memory burden; professions are more useful identifiers than names at this stage.
Nothing currently supports a unique culprit. Do not treat suspicious wording, professional access, or innocent characters' claims as conclusive.
